adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure in `handleAdd`, but it is only reset in the Cancel button handler. When the dialog is closed via the `Dialog`'s `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` (e.g., overlay click/Escape), neither `isInvalidEmail` nor `multiEmailValue` is reset. Also, `onSuccess` resets `multiEmailValue` and closes the dialog but does not reset `isInvalidEmail`, so the error state can persist across re-opens or after successful submission.
